report_name: Ransomware Attack Disrupts Colombia's Ministry of Justice

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Ransomware Group
threat_actors.description: The unidentified ransomware group responsible for the attack against Colombia's Ministry of Justice.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware attack encrypted government files at Colombia's Ministry of Justice, disrupting public services including systems for legal processes and monitoring of illicit drugs.

identities.name: Colombia's Ministry of Justice
identities.description: The government body of Colombia that was the victim of a ransomware attack, resulting in file encryption and disruption of public services.

indicators.name: Ransomware Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Note File Creation
id: 2b1c3d4e-5f6a-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the creation of common ransomware note filenames.'
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/17th-august-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - 'readme.txt'
      - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.html'
      - 'DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Monitors for the creation of files with common ransom note names like readme.txt or DECRYPT_INSTRUCTIONS.html across multiple directories.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: f8a1b2c3-d4e5-4f6a-b7c8-d9e0f1a2b3c4
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware precursor activity to inhibit system recovery.'
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/17th-august-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects command-line execution of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a technique used by ransomware to prevent recovery.

indicators.name: Disabling Of Security Tools Via Service Control
indicators.pattern:
title: Disabling Of Security Tools Via Service Control
id: 9c8d7e6f-5a4b-4c3d-2b1a-0f9e8d7c6b5a
status: experimental
description: 'Detects attempts to stop common antivirus or EDR services using sc.exe or net.exe.'
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/17th-august-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-17
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_sc:
    Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'stop'
  selection_net:
    Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'stop'
  selection_services:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'WinDefend'
      - 'MsMpEng'
      - 'Sense'
      - 'SAVService'
      - 'Sophos'
      - 'EPMService'
  condition: (selection_sc or selection_net) and selection_services
indicators.description: Generates high-priority alerts for any attempts to stop or tamper with antivirus, EDR, or logging services using standard Windows utilities.
